ns2:course.label: Senior Honors in Architecture
ns2:course.description: For candidates for honors in architecture. Independent guided study and research in a selected area of architecture. 3 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit. (Summer session, 1 to 3 undergraduate hours). May be repeated to a maximum of 6 hours with consent of Director of School. Prerequisite: Senior standing in architecture, a University grade-point average of 3.0 or, in special cases, consent of Director of School.
